sentences.text: The present criminal petition is filed seeking to call for the records pertaining to Crime No.127 of 2018 dated 14.11.2018 before the Sirivella Police Station, Kurnool District and to quash the same.
The said crime was registered for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 328, 273 r/w 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Sections 26 and 30(1) of the Food Safety and Standards Act.
Now, Learned Special Assistant Public Prosecutor submitted that the police laid the charge sheet and the trial was conducted and the accused were acquitted.
Therefore, nothing remains for further adjudication in the present criminal petition.
In view of the said submission, the present Criminal Petition is dismissed as infructuous.
As a sequel, miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in this Criminal Petition shall stand closed.
__ JUSTICE TARLADA RAJASEKHAR RAO Date:09.01.2024 KBN THE HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE TARLADA RAJASEKHARA RAO CRIMINAL PETITION No.13857 OF 2018 Date:09.01.2024 KBN
